title: Golf Club of Avon
specs: Heated pool with zero level entry
Eight har tru tennis courts, three paddle tennis courts, and four new pickleball courts

Neat, appropriate casual attire required; no denim on golf course, practice areas, or tennis courts; collared shirts required in Formal Dining Room on Friday and Saturday nights; hats and visors only allowed in Pub and not worn backward

options.name: Full Golf Membership
options.detail: Full access to all club facilities including unlimited golf on 27-hole course, practice facilities, tennis, paddle, pool, clubhouse, dining, and social events.

options.name: Full Family Membership
options.detail: All family members have access to golf course and all other club amenities.

options.name: Full Individual Membership
options.detail: One adult golfer has golf course access; family has privileges to other amenities; family members can use golf course with greens fee.

options.name: Sports Membership
options.detail: Access to all club facilities including 12 rounds of golf total among family members with no green fee, tennis, paddle, pool, clubhouse, dining, and social events; includes family privileges.

options.name: Social Dining Membership
options.detail: Access to clubhouse, dining rooms, and all social events; includes family privileges.

blurb: The Golf Club of Avon offers a 27-hole championship golf course, tennis and paddle courts, a heated pool with zero entry, and various dining and social events. It is a private club with multiple membership categories to suit different needs. The club has facilities and programs for families and individuals year-round.
